_note: Zone roster. Each zone is its own raid map chosen on the raid-select screen. Design numbers live here; geometry and positions live in World & Level's data/zone7.json keyed by the same ids. Look notes follow Brandon's direction: ethereal, misty, grounded; glow is an accent on creatures, fungi and liquid light, never a neon wash.

glowmireIsle.label: Glowmire Isle
glowmireIsle.pitch: The first island: a misty floating isle of liquid-light marsh and giant pale fungi, ringed by void.
glowmireIsle.look: soft fog, pale bioluminescent fungi, slow liquid-light falls over the rim, dusk sky with a ringed planet; colour in accents only
structures: Hollow Chitin Tower (3 floors, spiral ramp, loot on each floor, sniper roost on top)
Long Seed Debris Field (torn hull sections you can walk through, cargo crates, black box)
Sunken Bowl (the Reliquary's arena)
Fungal Caves under the east cliff (dark, tight, Glasswalker ambushes; the Pale Vigil hangs in the main chamber)
glowmireIsle.lootFocus: organs and first viruses; the Reliquary Heart
glowmireIsle.extracts: two Seed Spires (north from the start, east opens at 4:00)
glowmireIsle.why: learn the loop, farm organs for Mother Clot and the Gestation Vat, take the Reliquary when ready

longSeedWreck.label: Wreck of the Long Seed
longSeedWreck.pitch: Inside the crashed seedship: corridors, cargo holds, crew warrens and a reactor that is not quite dead.
longSeedWreck.look: dark interior lit by failing amber emergency strips and green embryo tanks, roots breaking through bulkheads, dust in shafts of light from hull breaches, outside a sliver of the misty island
structures: Breached Prow (exterior entry ramp, open sky)
Cargo Holds (big rooms, stacked crates, flanking routes over the top)
Crew Warrens (tight corridors, doors, vents the Wraith can crawl)
Embryo Gallery (rows of glass tanks; some hatch when you pass)
Sealed Lockers (need Seed Keys)
Reactor Chamber (the Warden's arena; catwalks; 4 coolant valves)
longSeedWreck.lootFocus: tech (Synapse Lenses, Coolant Rods, Black Boxes, Embryo Pods) and sealed-room jackpots

powerState.description: inserting 3 Coolant Rods at the reactor console restores power: sealed doors open, lights come on, the escape pods work, and the Warden wakes (Host)

mechanics.doors: bulkhead doors open slowly and loudly; the Behemoth can force them

longSeedWreck.extracts: Breached Prow (always), Escape Pod Bay (only with power restored; fast, 5 s), Cargo Lift (paid 100 DNA)
longSeedWreck.why: tech for the Archivist and the Memory Coral, Seed-Key gambling on sealed lockers, and later the Warden's core

expanse.label: The Expanse
expanse.pitch: The full 1 km of Zone 7: five biomes, rival hosts, shifting extracts and anomalies.
expanse.look: long sightlines through haze, floating island chains, the Lumen Grazers drifting overhead
expanse.lootFocus: everything; the Lumen Grazer's lantern glands; rival hosts' loadouts
expanse.why: the big PvPvE zone: long raids, rivals, the richest and riskiest loot

hollowChoir.label: The Hollow Choir
hollowChoir.pitch: A vertical cave-cathedral under Zone 7 where sound is light: noise makes the walls glow and gives you away.
hollowChoir.look: black stone, mineral curtains, light that only blooms where sound hits it
hollowChoir.why: stealth zone; Wraith territory; a choir-boss at the bottom

soundIsLight.note: any noise lights the walls around you for 2 s; creatures see the light

ossuaryReef.label: The Ossuary Reef
ossuaryReef.pitch: A dried sea floor of bone coral in low gravity, drifting between ribs of things the size of mountains.
ossuaryReef.look: pale bone, dust, a huge dim sun, slow floating debris
ossuaryReef.why: Behemoth territory; huge open fights; the hardest zone

ochreReach.label: The Ochre Reach
ochreReach.pitch: A sun-baked alien savannah under three suns and a ringed planet: red dust, lone umbrella trees, a dead settler colony of clay domes and drill rigs, and things under the sand.
ochreReach.look: hot haze and blowing dust, low-saturation ochre and rust, three soft suns, the ring planet huge in the sky, blue-veined trees; no neon
ochreReach.reference: Brandon's desert image (inspiration only: our creatures are not the ones in it)
structures: Settler Domes (a village of clay domes and tin lean-tos, enterable, lockers inside; Shroudlings nest here)
Rig Yard (rusted derricks and lookout towers with ladders; sniper roosts)
Acacia Flats (open grass and lone trees; the Bristleback herds)
Dune Sea (shifting dunes; Dunewake burrows)
Cactus Gulch (a narrow canyon run with cover)
Skyfall Crater (where ring debris fell; the Sandwidow's arena)
ochreReach.lootFocus: settler tech and guns in the domes, Bristleback cisterns, the Sandwidow's eggs

heat.note: noon sun slowly fills Overload outside shade

ochreReach.extracts: three: the rig lift (north), a settler crawler (east), a paid sky-tether (crater rim)
ochreReach.why: open long-range fights, herds to stampede, a village to clear room by room

marrowPit.label: The Marrow Pit
marrowPit.pitch: A vertical shaft hundreds of metres deep, strung with rickety walkways, cables and hanging huts. The deeper you go the stranger, stronger and richer it gets, and the further it is back up.
marrowPit.look: dark stone and roots, mist in shafts of grey light from above, warm lamp glow on the walkways, a sickly green glow from the bottom; no neon
structures: Rim Camp (scaffold, winches and the lift; spawn and the main extract)
Cable Bridges (rope and bone walkways across the shaft)
Hanging Warren (huts lashed to the cliff on platforms)
Bone Gallery (caves cut into the walls, full of the Hollowed)
The Undermouth (the pit floor; the Nethermaw)
marrowPit.lootFocus: the deeper the better: pit crates up top, deep caches near the floor, the Nethermaw's lobes

fall.note: a fall of more than 18 m kills; walkways can be cut

climbBack.note: every metre down is a metre to climb back

marrowPit.extracts: the rim lift (always); the updraft at the bottom (only once the Nethermaw is dead)
marrowPit.why: push-your-luck descent: every layer is richer and deadlier, and the only easy way out is up

weepingFen.label: The Weeping Fen
weepingFen.pitch: A drowned swamp under giant mushroom-trees: knee-deep black water, glowing moss, mist, long-necked giants wading through it, and something in the deep pool.
weepingFen.look: teal mist and black water, moss glow as accents, huge pale cap-trees, roots like cathedrals, a coloured campfire smoke; restrained, not neon
structures: Root Hut (a dwelling grown into a giant root, with a ladder inside the trunk)
Mushroom Cathedral (the tallest cap-trees; climbable caps)
Stilt Village (drowned houses on stilts, rope bridges)
Mistwader Shallows (open shallows, the giants graze)
Spider Hollow (Mirebrood nest around an old fire)
Drowned Pod (a sunken seedship pod, half under water, locker inside)
Regent Pool (deep black pool ringed by root islands; the Mire Regent)
weepingFen.lootFocus: root hollows and stilt houses, the drowned pod's tech, Mistwader hearts, the Regent's pearls

water.note: wading is slow and loud; Fenstalkers hear it

weepingFen.extracts: three: the stilt-village ferry, a root-lift in the cathedral, and a paid swim-out at the pool's outflow
weepingFen.why: slow, tense wading; ambushes from the water; a rich passive giant to hunt if you dare
